Messages.Author: CYLee
Messages.Body:
I've just finished reading the new FAQ for Jyhad that were posted
in announcements section of the trading cards game newsgroup. I have 3
questions that came to mind when I was reading it.

1) MInor Boon. Does it prevent Amaranth from happening if you play it to
prevent the aggro. dam. from happening?

2) Maneuvers on weapons. Can you use the optional maneuver on your other
weapon after the 1st maneuver on the weapon you wanted to use is cancelled?
(ie:- use the Sat. night Special's maneuver after the .44 Magnum's
manuever is cancelled ) And if yes, which weapon do you have to use for
your strike?

3)Cloak the Gathering . Can you use it on another Meth.'s minion to give
it the +1 stealth? I.e.:- Give your prey's political ally +1 stealth to
bleed his prey during your prey's turn?

Thank's for your time,
CYLEE, Caitiff Justicar

Messages.Author: Intimate apperal
Messages.Body:
On Sat, 15 Apr 1995, CYLee wrote:

> I've just finished reading the new FAQ for Jyhad that were posted
> in announcements section of the trading cards game newsgroup. I have 3
> questions that came to mind when I was reading it.
>
> 1) MInor Boon. Does it prevent Amaranth from happening if you play it to
> prevent the aggro. dam. from happening?
>

I have the cards in front of me, and it seems that minor boon would take
precedence. Amaranth allows one to diablerize rather than letting the
vampire go to torpor. When minor boon is played, the vampire would not go
to torpor anyway , thus eliminating one of the necessery elements required
for amaranth to be played, that being that the vampire has to be on the
way to torpor.

> 2) Maneuvers on weapons. Can you use the optional maneuver on your other
> weapon after the 1st maneuver on the weapon you wanted to use is cancelled?
> (ie:- use the Sat. night Special's maneuver after the .44 Magnum's
> manuever is cancelled ) And if yes, which weapon do you have to use for
> your strike?
>

I believe this is not possible. Since one is bound to strike with a
weapon after using the manuver on it, and there is only one strike
allowed, I don't see how you could use two weapon manuvers. Perhaps it
would be possible through additional strikes, but I really wouldn't
know. You really should go back to those deer rifles.

> 3)Cloak the Gathering . Can you use it on another Meth.'s minion to give
> it the +1 stealth? I.e.:- Give your prey's political ally +1 stealth to
> bleed his prey during your prey's turn?
>

Cloak the gathering can only give minions you control stealth. I.E. say
your predator's predator had Lydia, with Pulse of the Canaille, and
bonding, or something nasty like that. You could not use CtG to give
Lydia extra stealth, because she does not fit the role of "acting minion
you control"

- tony, Prince of Iowa City

Messages.Author: Shane Hamish William Travis
Messages.Body:
CYLee (cy...@blue.weeg.uiowa.edu) wrote:

: 1) MInor Boon. Does it prevent Amaranth from happening if you play it to
: prevent the aggro. dam. from happening?

Believe so. Not 100% sure on this one though.

: 2) Maneuvers on weapons. Can you use the optional maneuver on your other
: weapon after the 1st maneuver on the weapon you wanted to use is cancelled?
: (ie:- use the Sat. night Special's maneuver after the .44 Magnum's
: manuever is cancelled ) And if yes, which weapon do you have to use for
: your strike?

Absolutely not. Using the inherent maneuver from a weapon restricts your
choice at strike declaration to that weapon and that weapon only; thus,
were you to use the maneuver from another weapon, you would be forced to
use two weapns on the same strike - and that is just not possible.

Now if you had a retainer, and _he_ wanted to use your extra gun and the
maneuver therein, I don't see why that wouldn't be allowed.

: 3)Cloak the Gathering . Can you use it on another Meth.'s minion to give
: it the +1 stealth? I.e.:- Give your prey's political ally +1 stealth to
: bleed his prey during your prey's turn?

CtG is an action modifier, not a reaction. One cannot play action
modifiers when one's minion is not taking the original actions, nor can
one play action modifiers when it is not one's turn.

Messages.Author: CurtAdams
Messages.Body:
CYLee (cy...@blue.weeg.uiowa.edu) wrote:

: 1) MInor Boon. Does it prevent Amaranth from happening if you play it to

: prevent the aggro. dam. from happening?

It feels like it should. However, the rule on attempts to play cards at
the same time that would negate each other is that the acting minion's
Methuseleh cards go first, followed by the blocker, followed by other
Methuselehs.

Hence if the acting Meth plays Amaranth, it will go off before any Meth
can play Minor Boon, and there's no vampire to Boon. If the blocker plays
it, only the acting Methuseleh could play Minor Boon first, and he can't
play it on his own vampire.

So Amaranth wins.

Curt Adams (curt...@aol.com)

>choice at strike declaration to that weapon and that weapon only; thus,
>were you to use the maneuver from another weapon, you would be forced to
>use two weapns on the same strike - and that is just not possible.
>
>Now if you had a retainer, and _he_ wanted to use your extra gun and the
>maneuver therein, I don't see why that wouldn't be allowed.

In general, retainers can't use equipment or deal damage in combat.
Ghoul Retainer may be able to get away with using another weapon's
maneuver.

>: 3)Cloak the Gathering . Can you use it on another Meth.'s minion to give
>: it the +1 stealth? I.e.:- Give your prey's political ally +1 stealth to
>: bleed his prey during your prey's turn?
>
>CtG is an action modifier, not a reaction. One cannot play action
>modifiers when one's minion is not taking the original actions, nor can
>one play action modifiers when it is not one's turn.

Action modifiers can be played when it's not your turn, but they do
still have to modify your own minion's actions, so the only way you
could play them on someone else's turn in through MMN.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
sht...@duke.usask.ca (Shane Hamish William Travis) writes:

>CYLee (cy...@blue.weeg.uiowa.edu) wrote:

>: 1) MInor Boon. Does it prevent Amaranth from happening if you play it to
>: prevent the aggro. dam. from happening?

>Believe so. Not 100% sure on this one though.

No. Minor Boon does not prevent the damage from happening.

The acting player's card has precedence. If she plays Amaranth, then the
blocker is burned. If she plays Minor Boon (under a house rule allowing
Master-Out-of-Turn cards to be played, or if she were controlling a
Malkavian who was taking an action on someboidy else's turn via Madness
Network), then Amaranth could not be played, as the blocker is no longer
going to torpor.

>: 2) Maneuvers on weapons. Can you use the optional maneuver on your other
>: weapon after the 1st maneuver on the weapon you wanted to use is cancelled?
>: (ie:- use the Sat. night Special's maneuver after the .44 Magnum's
>: manuever is cancelled ) And if yes, which weapon do you have to use for
>: your strike?

>Absolutely not. Using the inherent maneuver from a weapon restricts your
>choice at strike declaration to that weapon and that weapon only; thus,
>were you to use the maneuver from another weapon, you would be forced to
>use two weapns on the same strike - and that is just not possible.

>Now if you had a retainer, and _he_ wanted to use your extra gun and the
>maneuver therein, I don't see why that wouldn't be allowed.

Retainers (specifically Ghoul Retainers) who use weapons may not contribute
manuevers. Sorry.

>: 3)Cloak the Gathering . Can you use it on another Meth.'s minion to give
>: it the +1 stealth? I.e.:- Give your prey's political ally +1 stealth to
>: bleed his prey during your prey's turn?

>CtG is an action modifier, not a reaction. One cannot play action
>modifiers when one's minion is not taking the original actions, nor can
>one play action modifiers when it is not one's turn.

True.

Messages.Author: Joseph Cochran
Messages.Body:

CurtAdams <curt...@aol.com> wrote:
>CYLee (cy...@blue.weeg.uiowa.edu) wrote:

>: prevent the aggro. dam. from happening?
>

>It feels like it should. However, the rule on attempts to play cards at
>the same time that would negate each other is that the acting minion's
>Methuseleh cards go first, followed by the blocker, followed by other
>Methuselehs.

I think Minor Boon is more akin to the damage-preventing cards,
and there *is* the opportunity to play those to stop the Amaranth (you
have to be going to torpor, and if that is stopped, you can't play
Amaranth). You can't gloss by a sub-phase, and if I want to play a card
in the damage prevention sub-phase, you can't stomp on me with Amaranth.
While we both try to play them at the same physical time, you have to
wait to play Amaranth until the damage prevention sub-phase is gone.
So, I would say that Minor Boon *does* prevent Amaranth.

If you get to begin with four transfers:

Turn 1: 4 Caitiffs down, play info highway, bring out 2 caitiffs and
buy 1 more. You now have three Caitiffs down and two up.

Turn 2: Play EM, you now have four caitiffs down and two up. Bring out
two caitiffs and buy one more. You now have four caitiffs up and three
down.

Turn 3a: Play another EM, you now have four Caitiffs up and four down.
In your influence phase you get four Caitiffs up totaling eight. You
could even have two capacity 2 vampires in addition.

But I don't see this happening "usually".

If you begin with fewer transfers then this should be figured anew.
The two extra transfers at the end suggest that you could do it.
